# Twine

> A global freelancer marketplace connecting 460k+ creative professionals with clients across design, development, marketing, music, and AI services.

Twine is a comprehensive platform for hiring specialized freelancers and finding remote work opportunities. It serves both clients seeking quality creative talent and freelancers looking for projects across multiple disciplines including web development, graphic design, digital marketing, video production, and AI data services.

## Key Topics

- Freelancer marketplace
- Creative services
- Web development
- Graphic design
- Digital marketing
- Music production
- Video and animation
- Remote work
- Job marketplace
- AI data collection
- App development
- Content creation
- Freelance jobs
- Service directory
- Enterprise solutions

## Hire Freelancers by Category

- [Browse All Freelancers](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer): Main directory to browse and hire from 460k+ freelancers across creative services
- [Graphic Design Services](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/graphic-design): Graphic design freelancer directory featuring logo, web, branding, and illustration services
- [Video and Animation Services](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/video-and-animation): Directory of video and animation freelancers specializing in 3D, 2D, and motion graphics
- [Web and App Development](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/programming): Web and app development freelancers skilled in React, Angular, NextJS, and Vue
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/digital-marketing): Digital marketing experts for SEO, social media, PPC, content creation, and copywriting
- [Music and Audio Services](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/music): Music and audio freelancers offering production, voiceover, mixing, and composition
- [Business Services](https://www.twine.net/hire-a-freelancer/business): Business and startup service experts for branding, design, and digital marketing

## Find Freelance Work

- [All Freelance Jobs](https://www.twine.net/jobs): Job marketplace for freelancers to find and apply for remote projects globally
- [Freelancer Platform](https://www.twine.net/freelancers): Freelancer platform offering 150+ specialisms including design, dev, music, and marketing
- [Creative Freelance Jobs](https://www.twine.net/freelance/creatives): Creative freelance jobs in design, animation, web development, music, and video
- [Developer Jobs](https://www.twine.net/freelance/developers): Developer jobs in web, app, backend, UI/UX, product management, and AI engineering
- [Marketing Freelance Jobs](https://www.twine.net/freelance/marketing): Marketing freelance jobs covering social media, SEO, PPC, content, and PR
- [AI Data Collector Jobs](https://www.twine.net/freelance/data-collector): Gig work for AI data collection contributing visual and audio content to datasets

## AI Services

- [Twine AI Data Services](https://www.twine.net/ai): Twine AI service for data collection, annotation, and labeling for AI model training

## Getting Started

- [How Twine Works](https://www.twine.net/howitworks): Platform overview explaining hiring process, expert matching, and payment solutions
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.twine.net/enterprise): Enterprise pricing and job boost packages for reaching top talent quickly
